repository.license_note: Only Detection/LICENSE exists; it is component-specific.

medical_source.declared_sigma: A second bias-free Conv3d is declared but its weight is unused in the active GAS forward.
medical_source.noise_sampling: torch.randn_like(mu) multiplied elementwise by inverse-minmax gradient scale
medical_source.gradient_state_type: nn.Parameter grad_update accessed and assigned through .data
medical_source.gradient_state_update_timing: after backward and before optimizer.step; therefore used by the next forward
medical_source.stochastic_switch: forward(stochastic=True), but parent model calls classifier without overriding the default
medical_source.evaluation_behavior: stochastic by default even when model.eval() is set

natural_source.gradient_state_value: squared head_weight gradient copied by a backward hook
natural_source.evaluation_behavior: forward always samples noise; no stochastic/eval switch in the audited file

comparison.paper_readme: README gives the conceptual claim that parameters with smaller/changing gradients receive less perturbation and saturated/overfit weights receive more; it does not define an executable update schedule.
comparison.actual_source: Medical and natural paths differ in state container, noise magnitude, and control flow. The medical path uses the previous backward gradient; the natural path updates a buffer via a hook.
comparison.srgas_contract: SR-GAS V0.1 remains authoritative: same-step clean autograd sensitivity, variance 0.1, explicit generator, detached sensitivity/noise, no master-weight mutation, and deterministic evaluation.
